name: hermes_outcome_grader_post_close_lq275_20261107
comment: daily_close_cache took the last quote of each New York calendar day from market_quotes. The
poller runs after the bell, so that is an after-hours print (XLK 2026-11-05: 161.75 vs official
162.45); before the 11-07 ORDER BY fix it was often the 07:15 pre-market print, which shifted the
cache one session (PWR 11-04/05/06 held the closes of 11-03/04/05); yfinance and weekend rows
also landed and the grader built its session calendar from those dates.
Fix: the data-broker projection lib.data_broker.session_close returns, per NYSE session, the
next session's first prev_close fetched after the official close (16:00 ET, 13:00 on early-close
days), else the first print within 5 minutes of the close, else nothing. alpaca/finviz only.
The grader's cache refresh inserts from that same SELECT; an official close is never overwritten
by a provisional one; _sessions keeps only NYSE trading days.
The gate pins: calendar sessions (early close, weekend/holiday skip), yfinance rejected, the
timestamp checks in both CTEs, ASC first-after-close ordering, named params complete, the
refresh window and backfill chunks, the official-wins precedence, weekend rows not shifting the
Hermetic: fake cursors and a fake db_query; no database, no network.
